title: Step 0 - Download the Starting Files
section: 20. Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game
summary: Download and open the Simon starter project and look around before coding.

concepts.heading: Starter project
points: Download the zip from the Course Resources button (top left of the lesson), unzip it and open the folder in the code editor.
Contents: index.html with four pre-styled button divs, styles.css, and a sounds folder with one mp3 per colour plus a wrong-answer sound.
Open index.html in Chrome (copy its full path into the address bar) to see the static layout.
The following lessons are numbered steps that add the behaviour one piece at a time.

concepts.heading: Pieces the HTML already provides
points: An h1 with id level-title, initially 'Press A Key to Start'.
Four divs with class btn plus a colour class, each with an id equal to the colour (green, red, yellow, blue). Those ids are what the JS will use to pick buttons and name sound files.
(Extra) styles.css already defines .pressed (grey + white glow) and .game-over (red body, 0.8 opacity), which later steps toggle.
